items.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997
items.q: Stanley Dance is mentioned only as the author of a book ('The World of Duke Ellington by Stanley Dance') which contains a story about the interviewee meeting Harry Carney. The interviewee does not describe a personal relationship with Stanley Dance.

ctx.x: When did you first get on the baritone? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

Actually in 1956 maybe? My alto was — this is on the back of one of my albums, I can’t remember which one. But my alto needed some repair and as usual I’d take it to the music store. And they always let me take an alto. They had no altos but they had a baritone. So I said “I don’t want to play that.” “Oh gee, you’re only going to play it tonight, take it. It’s just like an alto only it’s bigger. You’ve just got to blow harder.” That’s what he told me. So I took it on the gig and I didn’t like it at all. Everybody…
It’s pretty heavy too. © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
